thread:
sam: heads up, several customers hit SSO failures this morning, started ~07:12 UTC. getting SAML Assertion Audience mismatch after our proxy.
priya: :eyes: which SP? can you paste the raw assertion (redact PII) and the exact error from the app?
sam: SP=redwood-console-prod. error from app: "Assertion audience http://console.redwood.ai does not match request audience https://proxy.internal". assertion excerpt:
```
<AudienceRestriction>
  <Audience>http://console.redwood.ai</Audience>
</AudienceRestriction>
```
jules: are we stripping or rewriting audience via the auth-proxy? last deploy had the proxy header change.
mike: rolling back auth-proxy patch now, but also saw some SCIM deprovision jobs failing with KMS decrypt errors earlier — could be related to key alias swap.
sam: interesting. timeline: 06:58 SCIM bulk deprov started -> several KMS decrypt errors in logs -> 07:02 auth-proxy deploy -> 07:12 SSO failures spike.
priya: post the KMS error log lines? sample:
```
2026-02-15T06:59:01Z scim-worker ERROR decrypt failed: KMS.Decrypt RPC failed: InvalidCiphertextException
2026-02-15T06:59:01Z scim-worker ERROR user_id=usr_42 deprovision aborted
```
jules: InvalidCiphertextException usually means wrong key/material. Did ops rotate alias today?
mike: ops ran a key re-wrap for extid last night but not for scim envelope key. I see a partial rekey job in ksm-runner with status=FAILED at 06:50.
sam: proxy rollback in progress — infra-bot shows canary rollback for auth-proxy at 07:16.
infra-bot: rollback initiated by @mike (run-id 9b3f). canary 1/3 -> 0/3 healthy -> full rollback succeeded.
priya: rollback didn't touch KMS. hypothesis: failed rekey left some envelopes unreadable -> scim worker threw errors -> user deprov retries created inconsistent session state -> when proxy rewrote Audience header it exposed mismatch downstream.
jules: makes sense. action items: (1) surface all KMS rekey jobs and their status; (2) retry failed envelope rewraps from last good snapshot; (3) run a small SCIM re-sync in dry-run to confirm.
mike: I've queued rewrap job for envelopes with failed flag. Also will add a safeguard to auth-proxy to preserve original Audience when forwarding SAML POSTs.
sam: for incident timeline and audit: we need SSO audit events for 07:00-07:30 and SCIM audit logs for 06:50-07:10. I only see partial entries in CloudAudit.
priya: could be log pruning. retention policy shouldn't kick in that fast. file a ticket to storage team, but first capture current logs: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND timestamp>\"2026-02-15T06:45:00Z\"" --limit 200`.
jules: vuln note: while rewrapping we use lib-crypto v2.1.5 — CVE-2026-9999 was patched in 2.1.6. Ops, check if any nodes still on 2.1.5.
mike: scanning nodes now, will report.
sam: do we need a mitigations runbook? I'm drafting a short incident notice: impacted console SSO login for subset of customers, SCIM deprovision delays, no evidence of data exfil.
priya: add that we paused automated deprovisions and are doing manual cleanup for high-risk customers until rewrap completes.
mike: node scan: 3/72 nodes running lib-crypto 2.1.5 in scim-worker autoscale group. I'll rollout update tonight and cordon/replace the 3 now if needed.
jules: rewrap job completing ETA ~12m. once rewrap done, run a targeted SCIM requeue for failed deprovs: `scimctl requeue --filter=status:failed --since=2026-02-15T06:30:00Z`.
sam: thanks. keep thread updated. I'll prepare the incident timeline for postmortem. :thumbsup:
priya: tagging security oncall @jules to start vuln triage doc.
jules: starting vuln doc now, will include timelines, KMS key-id, rewrap job ids, and audit gaps.
mike: all right, rewrap complete for 98% envelopes, 42 still flagged for manual review. continuing.
sam: last check: console SSO success rate back to normal after rollback. monitoring for 30m, will escalate if regressions.
priya: added remediation checklist to incident ticket, linking logs and job ids. closing out here when logs fully recovered.
